title: Bali Honeymoon Package | Coastal Adventures and Romantic Nights
highlights: Discover the vibrant charm of Bali, with Kuta's lively beaches and Seminyak's upscale boutiques and dining, blending culture, relaxation, and adventure.
Hike to the summit of the active Mount Batur volcano and witness a stunning sunrise over Lake Batur and the Bali skyline.
Set sail on a magical sunset dinner cruise with breathtaking ocean views, live entertainment, and a gourmet international buffet, perfect for a romantic evening.
Visit the iconic Uluwatu Temple perched on a cliff, overlooking the Indian Ocean.
Savor a romantic candlelight dinner with your loved one, set against Bali’s enchanting tropical backdrop for an unforgettable evening.
overview:
About the destination:
Bali, one of the most popular destinations for honeymooners, offers an enchanting blend of beautiful beaches, serene coastlines, temples, lush green rice terraces, and charming waterfalls. It is an ideal place to start your journey of togetherness. Stroll hand in hand, barefoot, along the stunning Kuta Beach, renowned for its party-centric atmosphere and its ability to captivate travellers from around the world. Bali has much in store for you and your partner, promising a perfect romantic getaway.

know_before_you_go: Personal expenses and mandatory hotel taxes (if any) will have to be paid by you at the destination.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travellers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.

Thrillophilia reserves the right to rearrange the itinerary due to any kind of disturbance that occurred (i.e weather condition, political condition or any others) without changing the total number of days and without compromising any service.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
International / domestic flights are not included in the package.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance at your own cost.
ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Images are for representation purposes only.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Kuta | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel in Kuta. After checking in, enjoy the rest of the day at leisure. You can explore the vibrant city on your own by visiting attractions such as The Ground Zero Memorial, a tribute to the Bali bombing victims, the captivating Kuta Theater for cultural performances or relax at the serene Karma Beach. In the evening, you can stroll through the lively night markets, before returning to the hotel.

days.title: Trek to Mount Batur
days.desc: In the morning, board the transfer to the base of Mount Batur for an unforgettable trek. As you ascend, soak in the stunning views of the surrounding mountain ranges. Upon reaching the summit, be rewarded with breathtaking views of the sunrise over Lake Batur and the distant Mount Agung. The trek’s highlights include walking through volcanic terrain and witnessing the steam vents at the top. Afterwards, descend back to the starting point. Later, you'll be driven back to your hotel.

days.title: Bali Temple Tour and Monkey Forest
days.desc: Today, board the transfer for a captivating temple tour, beginning with the Taman Ayun Temple. Next, visit the iconic Tanah Lot Temple, perched on a rock formation by the sea, offering stunning views, especially at sunset. Continue to Uluwatu Temple, dramatically situated on a cliff overlooking the vast Indian Ocean, where you can witness a mesmerizing Kecak and Fire Dance performance. Explore the Kedaton Monkey Forest and relax on Padang Padang Beach. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Balinese Spa | Arrival in ​​Seminyak | Leisure Day
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel and get transferred for a Balinese Spa experience that will leave you feeling rejuvenated. Later, board the transfer to your hotel in Seminyak and check in. Later, you can explore the city on your own, visiting spots like Echo Beach, a hotspot for surfers, and vibrant beachside cafes. You'll find multi-concept stores in Jalan Laksmana, where you can stroll and shop around. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach | Sunset Dinner Cruise
days.desc: Today, board your transfer to Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can spend the day indulging in thrilling water sports such as banana boat rides and parasailing (at your own cost), while enjoying the vibrant beach atmosphere. Later, embark on an amazing Sunset Dinner Cruise, where you’ll enjoy the beautiful sunset views over the ocean. The cruise offers live entertainment and a delicious international buffet. After the cruise, you’ll be transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.desc: You can relax or spend the day exploring the city at your own pace, visiting cultural gems like Biasa Art Space, known for its contemporary art exhibitions, and Nyaman Gallery, which showcases collections of local and international artists. In the evening, experience a romantic candlelight dinner and create unforgettable memories with your partner. After dinner, return to your room for an overnight stay.
